connector.name: MCP Ksef Pl
connector.registryDescription: Polish e-invoicing MCP: KSeF API v2, FA(3)/FA(2) XML, Peppol BIS 3.0, NIP/REGON validation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-ksef-pl. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cmendezs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KSEF_SESSION_TOKEN
env.description: KSeF v2 AccessToken obtained via the challenge/redeem auth flow. Required for submit_invoice_to_ksef.

env.name: KSEF_NIP
env.description: NIP (Polish tax identifier, 10 digits) of the entity submitting invoices.
